input.request: I can see that our supplier batch is marked processed, but I need to know whether the payment on row SUP-17 was paid or rejected.

events.text: I’m authorised to view our payouts. The batch shows processed, but I can’t tell whether row SUP-17, for our studio materials supplier, was paid. Please check that row’s status.
My first action is to look up row SUP-17 in the previously authorised batch and verify the status of that line specifically.

summary: Leona Voss, a viewer on secure chat, asked the desk to check whether row SUP-17 in a payout batch (her studio materials supplier) was paid, since the batch only shows as processed. The desk read the case, classified it as a question about the batch, and put it into a waiting state because the payment system had been asked but its answer was not in. The agent's follow-up payment lookup was refused because the case was already in WAITING, so the status of SUP-17 has not been found and nothing has been shared. Leona is also not verified on this chat, so a person would need to verify her and then check the SUP-17 status in the payment records.
